GreenhouseId.name: greenhouse_id
GreenhouseId.description: Site-unique greenhouse identity; the same slug used in MQTT topics, controller REST paths, and DB rows (RFC-007).

OptimizerRunId.name: X-Optimizer-Run-Id
OptimizerRunId.description: The optimizer cycle's trace / provenance id (`optimizer_run_id`, a UUID). Optional and only meaningful for optimizer submissions: Phase 2 records it on the resulting `source = optimizer` intended-state revision so a stored bundle can be traced back to the cycle that produced it (P3-OBS-1, RFC-005). Absent on the operator's ad-hoc edit. As a trace header it never affects the write outcome — a present-but-malformed value is ignored (the submission still succeeds; provenance is simply not recorded).
